# runzero_site (Resource)

Manages a RunZero site.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the site.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the site.
- `excludes` (String) Excluded scan targets.
- `scope` (String) The scan scope for this site (CIDR ranges, etc.).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the site was created.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the site.
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the site was last updated.
